title: MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update: Just Flight AA-5, Supersonic T-50 & what’s worth it?
description:
Are you looking to expand your virtual hangar in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 this week, or are you deciding which new Marketplace add-ons are actually worth your hard-earned cash? Today, we are breaking down a diverse slate of new releases—ranging from supersonic jet training and regional airline hops to deep general aviation touring and precision flight dynamics upgrades!

In this marketplace breakdown, we take a close look at features, panel variants, realistic expectations, and new releases across the MSFS 2024 virtual flight line:

✈️ DEIMOS INC. T-50 GOLDEN EAGLE
We kick things off with the supersonic Korean trainer developed by Korea Aerospace Industries and Lockheed Martin. Powered by the GE F404 afterburning turbofan, this package brings high-G performance, synthetic vision, targeting cameras, multiple military liveries, and VR optimization to the sim. Plus, we highlight the Marketplace 1-day rental option so you can test it before buying.

✈️ AERODYNAMICS AIRBUS A319neo
Next, we examine Aerodynamics' low-cost narrowbody commercial jet. Featuring 15 included airline liveries and optimized external modeling, we discuss what to expect regarding interior depth, systems modeling, and price-to-performance before you commit your budget.

🛩️ JUST FLIGHT GRUMMAN AA-5 SERIES (TRAVELER, CHEETAH & TIGER)
The highlight of the week: Just Flight delivers the classic 4-seat light GA touring legend. We examine its 4 hot-swappable panel eras (from 1970s steam gauges to modern Garmin G1000 glass), dynamic interactive POH, walkaround support, icing effects, and authentic flight handling.

🎨 CESSNA 152 AUTHENTIC LIVERY PACK (BURNING BLUE DESIGN)
Looking to refresh your primary trainer? Burning Blue Design brings 15 crisp, real-world paint schemes compatible across both default trainer and aerial advertising configurations.

🚁 DHM INTERNATIONAL PXP BELL 407 FLIGHT MODEL PACK
Heading to the rotary wing fleet? We inspect the Pilot Experience Pack for the default iniBuilds Bell 407, delivering real-pilot tuned engine parameters, revised RPM response, corrected autorotation characteristics, and realistic tail rotor authority.

Which of these add-ons are you loading onto the flight line first? Taking the Just Flight AA-5 cross-country, test flying the T-50, or overhauling your Bell 407 rotor dynamics? Let us know in the comments below!

If you find these marketplace breakdowns helpful, don't forget to hit the like button, subscribe for weekly flight sim coverage, and clear skies on your next flight!
